about: Golden numbers for the data packs (intern guide §15). Tolerances were fixed before the run. Sources: textbook (The Mathematics of the Colour Negative) and the upstream data; 'recomputed' values come from the CHB-004 guide's own calculation, re-derived by tools/spektrafilm-export crosscheck.

entries.what: Portra 400 dye amounts, curves read at log H 0 (minima not subtracted)
spectral density of the grey card at 550 nm, and its parts (cyan, magenta, yellow, base)
neutral print filters, Portra 400 on Portra Endura, lamp TH-KG3 (C, M, Y in CC)
grey card, normalised paper log H (R, G, B) under the opaque reading
share of lamp (TH-KG3) x Portra Endura red sensitivity at >= 705 nm
CIE 1931 2 degree x, y, z at 555 nm
Portra 400 hanatos2025 erf4 window (c_uv, sigma_uv, c_ir, sigma_ir) in nm
128 negative-film x print pairs: median normalised spread of the mid-grey's paper log H under opaque (law: <= 0.06)
same median under zero-density on the spektrafilm pack (law must fail: > 0.06)
entries.source: recomputed by CHB-004 implementation; the guide's 0.52 is Filmbench data, where the dye rows marked missing were zeroed

entries.what: same median under zero-density on interim-filmbench@1
entries.checkedBy: tools/spektrafilm-export crosscheck (interim-filmbench@1 refuses zero-density in the loader: E_DATA_POLICY)
